annotations.title: One-time social insurance payment (BHXH một lần)

description: Estimate the one-time social insurance payment in Vietnam: 1.5 months of the average insurance salary for each year of contributions before 2014 and 2 months for each year from 2014; leftover months round to half or a full year; under one year it is the amount contributed, capped at 2 months of the average. Pass salary_history (years with monthly insurance salary; each year is indexed with the published BHXH coefficients) or an already indexed average_salary with months_before_2014 and months_from_2014. Eligibility is not checked. Examples: {"salary_history":[{"year":2012,"monthly_salary":5000000},{"year":2013,"monthly_salary":6000000},{"year":2025,"monthly_salary":15000000,"months":7}],"as_of":"2026-09"}; {"average_salary":12000000,"months_before_2014":30,"months_from_2014":50}.

as_of.description: Date of the social insurance agency's decision: YYYY-MM (first day of that month) or YYYY-MM-DD. Default: today in Vietnam. Supported from 2026-01; earlier dates are rejected.

average_salary.description: Alternative to salary_history: average monthly insurance salary, ALREADY indexed with the adjustment coefficients.

contributed_amount.description: Under one year of contributions only: the amount actually contributed; if omitted it is estimated at 22% of the salaries.

date.description: Synonym of as_of (same formats: YYYY-MM or YYYY-MM-DD). Pass only one of as_of, month, date.

month.description: Synonym of as_of (same formats: YYYY-MM or YYYY-MM-DD). Pass only one of as_of, month, date.

months_before_2014.description: With average_salary: months of contributions before 2014.

months_from_2014.description: With average_salary: months of contributions from 2014 on.

salary_history.description: Simple list of years: {year, monthly_salary, months (default 12)}. Each year is indexed with the published adjustment coefficient; months before 2014 and from 2014 are counted from the years.
